entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 17.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Korra P.S. Case No.211 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 414, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
4.
Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
Further, it has been submitted that the applicant has been made accused in this case on the basis of confession of the co-accused.
A tractor has been recovered at the instance of this applicant that was a stolen vehicle and this case has been lodged.
There is no material against this applicant except the confession.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

6. Considering the above facts and the period of custody, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned A.C.J.M., Hazaribag in connection with Korra P.S. Case No.211 of 2022, subject to condition that one of the bailors will be close relative of the applicant and the applicant will report to the concerned police station once in a month.

Further, the applicant(s) will submit self-attested photocopy/photocopies of his/her/their Aadhaar Card(s) and also submit his/her/their mobile number(s) before the learned court below which he/she/they will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
